corpus.note: Frozen before any model was scored. Every `relevant` target below was verified to exist in this corpus by verify-gold.mjs. D2 (2026-08-01): the corpus is now a PINNED worktree, not the live drifting repo — chunk_id is sha256(file_path + ':' + start_line), so line drift in the live tree silently invalidated targets and broke cross-time comparability (GITNEXUS_COMPARISON.md §14.2).

amendments.change: Dropped q19's second target (packages/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md L1620) — that file does not exist at corpus_sha 07d705b. q19 retains its first target (packages/workbench/fold/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md L1800), which resolves. Target count 43 -> 42.
amendments.why_this_repair: The target referenced a deleted file, so dropping it is mechanical. A SUBSTITUTE target was deliberately NOT chosen: hand-picking a replacement chunk would let the author bias the set toward an arm, which is the exact failure the Q1 provenance protocol exists to prevent.
amendments.effect_on_scores: q19's NDCG ceiling is computed over 1 relevant item instead of 2. This applies identically to every arm, so relative ranking is unaffected (same argument the README makes for the subset vector pool).

provenance_note: No production query log exists for MAST yet, so these 28 pairs are HAND-CONSTRUCTED to reproduce the Task-1 zero-result / near-miss class the rubric prioritizes: conceptual queries phrased in synonyms the target chunk does NOT contain (so trigram FTS ranks the true chunk low and the vector model must carry it), qualified method-name lookups, and cross-file concepts. Each query was written against a KNOWN real target chunk, then deliberately worded to minimize lexical overlap. This is a stated limitation (see README): a real miss-log would be higher-signal. Relevance is matched by file_path + symbol_name (code) or file_path + line-containment (doc/block).
match_rule: A returned chunk is relevant iff some target has the same file_path AND (target.symbol == chunk.symbol_name, OR target.line falls within [chunk.start_line, chunk.end_line]).
